name: inv_mul_cancel_of_le
docstring: The inverse cancels: for any real `a`, the product `a⁻¹ * a` is `1`.
why: The docstring drops `0 < a`; at `a = 0` the product is `0`, not `1`, so the docstring's reading is refutable. (2026-07-30: the original statement carried an inert `a ≤ b` hypothesis, a second defect one referee verdicted on; the binder was removed so the pair carries exactly the keyed defect.)
